passages.text: Know that though one may be a little bubble and another may be a mountain-high wave, yet behind both the bubble and the wave there is the infinite ocean. Therefore there is hope for every one.
passages.note: Hope for everyone, however small one feels

passages.text: One must learn sooner or later that one cannot get salvation if one does not try to seek the salvation of his brothers. You must try to combine in your life immense idealism with immense practicality.
passages.note: Balancing ideals with practical work and service

passages.text: The true man is he who is strong as strength itself and yet possesses a woman’s heart.
